events.title: Saturday tournament
events.description:
Lincoln Field, 1200 W Lincoln Ave, Anaheim, CA 92801

What to bring:
- Cleats and shin guards
- Both jerseys (home and away)
- Lunch and snacks
- Folding chair

Schedule: https://example.com/tournament/schedule
Games at 8:30, 11:00 and 1:30. Arrive 30 minutes early for check-in.
